title: Re-enter regions via update; alreadyExists for departed avatars
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[scene] Re-enter regions via update; alreadyExists for departed avatars
Spec (61f2d14): draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md L2189: "When the user already has a SceneAvatar record in the same region, whether present or departed, the server MUST NOT create a second record and MUST return an `alreadyExists` SetError ... A user who has left re-enters by updating that record." L2314: "re-enters the same region by updating their existing SceneAvatar record to set `leftAt` to `null`. The server sets `joinedAt` to the current time, `position` to the region's `spawnPosition`, and `orientation` to the region's `spawnOrientation`. ... The access checks and errors for entering a region apply."
Code: crate-jmap-scene-server/src/memory.rs:217-224; crate-jmap-scene-server/src/memory.rs:252-262; crate-jmap-scene-server/src/avatar.rs:461-475; crate-jmap-scene-server/src/memory.rs:834-851
Now: A create for a departed avatar silently reuses the record (memory.rs:252-262), and alreadyExists is returned only when leftAt is null. An update with leftAt:null is rejected: avatar.rs:464 says 'already left' and avatar.rs:470-474 'leftAt must be a UTCDate; re-enter with a create'. The memory update_object also re-checks double-leave on any leftAt key. Re-entry never resets orientation.
Change: In enter(), return alreadyExists with existingId for any existing record in the region. In update_avatar, accept leftAt:null when the stored leftAt is non-null, as re-entry: run the enter access checks (notFound), overQuota and auto-eject from other regions; set joinedAt=now and position/orientation from the region spawn; allow displayName/visual*/worldState in the same patch; recount activeAvatarCount. Keep double-leave invalid only for a non-null leftAt.
